meta.name: VGA screen
meta.description: A display of a SoC (Logisim-evolution's SoC VGA screen): a program draws by writing one 0xRRGGBB word per pixel into a frame buffer in memory, which the screen watches on its SoC bus; a mode register selects 160x120 up to 1024x768, and the part grows with the mode

bus.label: Bus
bus.title: The SoC bus the screen answers on and watches (Logisim-evolution's Connected bus)

startAddress.label: Base address (hex)
startAddress.title: Address of the 4-byte mode register (word access only): a read returns the modes software may select, writing one of their masks selects that mode

displayMode.label: Initial mode
displayMode.title: Resolution the screen starts with, until the program writes the mode register

bufferAddress.label: Pixel buffer address (hex)
bufferAddress.title: Address of the top-left pixel: the picture is one 0xRRGGBB word per pixel, row by row, in a memory on the same bus

soft160x120.label: Software 160x120
soft160x120.title: Whether the program may select 160x120 by writing its mask to the mode register

soft320x240.label: Software 320x240
soft320x240.title: Whether the program may select 320x240 by writing its mask to the mode register

soft640x480.label: Software 640x480
soft640x480.title: Whether the program may select 640x480 by writing its mask to the mode register

soft800x600.label: Software 800x600
soft800x600.title: Whether the program may select 800x600 by writing its mask to the mode register

soft1024x768.label: Software 1024x768
soft1024x768.title: Whether the program may select 1024x768 by writing its mask to the mode register

cExport.label: C header
cExport.title: Writes a C driver for this screen: <NAME>.h and <NAME>.c with the mode masks, the mode sizes, the addresses and the mode register's setter / getter (Logisim-evolution's Export C)

status.label: Status
status.title: The addresses the screen answers and watches and the mode in use

status.notConnected: Not connected to a bus: choose one in the Bus attribute

cExport.generated: Logic Design Studio automatically generated file for a VGA component
cExport.sizes: Width and height in pixels of every display mode.
cExport.addresses:
Addresses of this screen. The picture is one 0xRRGGBB word per pixel, row by row:
the pixel (x, y) is BUFFER[y * width + x] in the mode in use.
Initial mode: {{initial}}; modes software may select: {{allowed}}.
cExport.modeFunctions:
With the following functions the VGA mode can be manipulated.
Reading the VGA mode returns the supported modes (see the mode masks above).
Writing a supported mode mask changes the display mode of the VGA screen.

circ.idTooLong: The bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the VGA screen is not connected to a bus
circ.badStartAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit base address: 0x0 is used
circ.badBufferAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit pixel buffer address: 0x0 is used
circ.badDisplayMode: "{{value}}" is not a display mode (160x120, 320x240, 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768): {{used}} is used
